test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Acclame**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Acclame**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Acclaim**'.
 
• It means 'to express a very high opinion of something/somebody'. [किसी (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु) के प्रति आदर या प्रशंसा प्रकट करना; अभिनंदन करना]
 
 
• *Example: a highly **acclaimed** new film...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Acclame.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Progress**: movement forwards or towards achieving something. (आगे की ओर या लक्ष्‍य की ओर गति; प्रगति)
 
• **Vicious**: cruel; done in order to hurt somebody/something. [निर्मम; कटु, द्वेषपूर्ण (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को चोट पहुँचाने के लिए किया गया)]
 
• **Accuse**: to say that somebody has done something wrong or broken the law. (किसी व्‍यक्ति पर कुछ गलत करने का आरोप लगाना; क़ानून तोड़ने का दोषी ठहराना)

 
 
 

20b:T7e2,

The correct answer is **'No substitution required'.**
